privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Nyan Progress Bar ("we", "our", or "us") operates both a website and a Chrome extension. This Privacy Policy explains what information is collected, how it is used, and your rights.
privacy.s1Body: The website uses Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager to collect anonymised usage statistics (pages visited, session duration, country-level location). No personally identifiable information is collected via analytics. Data is processed by Google LLC under their privacy policy.
privacy.s1OptOutPre: You can opt out by installing the
privacy.s2Body1: The extension runs entirely in your browser and does not collect, transmit, or store any personal data on remote servers. The only data saved is your selected cat theme and any custom GIF you upload — both stored locally via the Chrome Storage API on your own device.
privacy.s2Body2: The extension requires access to youtube.com and music.youtube.com to inject the cat scrubber into the video player. It does not read or record your watch history, search queries, or any other YouTube activity.
privacy.s3Body: When you submit the contact form, your name, email address, and message are sent to our support inbox via email. This data is used solely to respond to your request and is not shared with third parties.
privacy.s3Rights: You may request deletion of your submission at any time by emailing us.
privacy.s4Body: The website stores your theme preference (dark/light mode) locally in the browser. No tracking cookies are set by us. Google Analytics may set its own cookies governed by Google's terms.
privacy.s5Intro: The website integrates the following third-party services:
privacy.s5Item1: Google Analytics / Google Tag Manager — anonymised usage analytics
privacy.s5Item2: Ko-fi, Patreon, Donatello — donation platforms (their own terms apply)
privacy.s5Body: The Chrome extension does not communicate with any external service.
privacy.s6Body: Google Analytics data is retained for 14 months. Contact form submissions are kept for as long as needed to resolve your request. Extension data (cat preference, custom GIF) is stored locally and deleted when you uninstall the extension.
privacy.s7Body: This policy may be updated from time to time. The "last updated" date at the top of this page reflects the most recent revision.
privacy.s8Pre: Questions about this policy? Email us at

index.heading: How to use Nyan Progress Bar
index.description: Step-by-step guides covering everything from installing the extension to fine-tuning your cat's position on the YouTube scrubber.

install.title: How to install Nyan Progress Bar
install.summary: Add the extension to Chrome in three clicks and see the cat on YouTube right away.
install.intro: Nyan Progress Bar is a free Chrome extension distributed through the Chrome Web Store. Installation takes less than a minute and works on any Chromium-based browser (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera).

steps.heading: Open the Chrome Web Store listing
steps.body: Visit the Nyan Progress Bar page on the Chrome Web Store. You can also reach it by clicking "Install on Chrome" from this site.

steps.heading: Click "Add to Chrome"
steps.body: The blue "Add to Chrome" button is in the top-right of the listing. Chrome will show a permissions prompt — the extension only asks for access to youtube.com and music.youtube.com so it can draw the cat on the scrubber.

steps.heading: Confirm the install
steps.body: Click "Add extension" in the confirmation dialog. The extension downloads (about 15 KB) and installs automatically. You'll see the Nyan icon appear in your toolbar.

steps.heading: Open YouTube and enjoy
steps.body: Head to youtube.com and start any video. The cat scrubber appears on the progress bar immediately — no reload, no sign-in, no setup. The default Nyan Cat is selected; you can change it any time from the popup.

choose-cat.title: How to choose a cat theme
choose-cat.summary: Open the popup, browse the cat grid, and pick from 12 built-in themes.
choose-cat.intro: The extension ships with 12 hand-tuned cat themes — from the classic Nyan Cat to a sleeping fat cat, a pixel cat, and several dancing variants. Switching is instant and persists across browser restarts.

steps.heading: Open the extension popup
steps.body: Click the Nyan icon in your browser toolbar. If you don't see it, click the puzzle-piece icon and pin Nyan Progress Bar for quick access. The popup opens at 280 px wide with the cat grid front and centre.

steps.heading: Browse the cat grid
steps.body: The grid shows all 12 built-in cats plus an upload tile for your own GIF. Scroll inside the grid to see every option. Each tile is a live preview of the actual GIF that will appear on the scrubber.

steps.heading: Click the cat you want
steps.body: Tap any cat tile to select it. The selected tile gets a cyan border and glow so you know which is active. The change is applied immediately to every open YouTube tab — no reload needed.

steps.heading: Check it on YouTube
steps.body: Switch to a YouTube tab and move the scrubber. Your new cat is already there. If you have YouTube Music open, the cat is updated there too.

choose-cat.outroPre: Want to use a GIF that's not in the grid?

upload-gif.title: How to upload a custom GIF
upload-gif.summary: Use any animated GIF you find online as your YouTube scrubber.
upload-gif.intro: Beyond the 12 built-in cats, you can upload any GIF and the extension will use it as your scrubber. The file is stored locally in your browser — nothing is uploaded to a server.

steps.heading: Find a GIF you like
steps.body: Browse GIPHY, Tenor, or Imgur for an animation. Smaller GIFs (under a few hundred kilobytes) feel snappier on the scrubber, but there's no hard size limit. Make sure the file you download has a .gif extension.

steps.heading: Open the extension popup
steps.body: Click the Nyan icon in your toolbar. The cat grid appears with an upload tile in the top-left — a dashed border with a + icon and "Upload GIF" text.

steps.heading: Click the upload tile
steps.body: A native file picker opens, filtered to .gif files. Pick the GIF you just downloaded and confirm. The extension reads it in the browser, stores it locally, and adds it as a new tile in the grid.

steps.heading: Your GIF is now your scrubber
steps.body: The uploaded GIF is selected automatically and pushed to every open YouTube tab. Open YouTube and move the scrubber to see it in action. To swap to a different GIF, click the upload tile again — the new file replaces the old one.

upload-gif.outroPre: GIF looking off-center on the scrubber?

adjust-position.title: How to adjust the cat's height and position
adjust-position.summary: Use the sliders in the popup to fine-tune how the cat sits on the scrubber.
adjust-position.intro: Every cat (and every uploaded GIF) has a different intrinsic size and shape, so the extension lets you nudge the height and vertical position to get it sitting perfectly on the YouTube progress bar.

steps.heading: Select a cat first
steps.body: Open the popup and pick the cat you want to tune. The "Adjust Position" controls only appear once a cat is selected — they apply per-cat, so each theme remembers its own settings.

steps.heading: Use the Height slider
steps.body: The Height slider ranges from 8 px to 80 px. Drag it and watch the cat resize on any open YouTube tab in real time. Taller cats look great on the main video player; smaller heights work better on hover thumbnails.

steps.heading: Use the Top offset slider
steps.body: The Top offset slider ranges from -50 px to +20 px. Negative values push the cat up; positive values push it down. Use this to centre the cat vertically on the scrubber line — different GIFs need different offsets depending on where the cat's feet are drawn.

steps.heading: Reset if needed
steps.body: Each cat has a pre-tuned default. If you over-adjust, click "Set default position" in the controls header to reset both sliders to the recommended values for that cat. Custom uploaded GIFs reset to a sensible fallback (28 px height, -13 px top).

adjust-position.outroPre: Want to preview cats before installing?
